detailed_descriptions_html.en:
【Restore Your Museum】

You’ve inherited a once-renowned museum that's now covered in dust and filled with misplaced artifacts. Can you bring it back to life?

【What You'll Do】

Clean and Restore

  • Remove dirt, clutter, and damage from exhibit halls.

  • Bring neglected rooms back to their former glory.

Organize Hundreds of Items

  • Find the rightful place for artifacts, fossils and museum pieces.

  • Turn chaotic collections into beautiful exhibits.

Learn and Unlock new areas

  • Learn about mysterious objects and determine where they belong.

  • Find keys to access locked exhibit rooms.

Assemble Dinosaur Skeletons

  • Collect fossils and piece together impressive prehistoric displays.

  • Complete skeletons part by part.

Level Up Your Skills

  • Earn XP as you restore the museum.

  • Unlock new abilities that help you repair increasingly complex exhibits.

【Prepare for the Grand Opening】

Every room cleaned, artifact identified, and exhibit restored brings the museum one step closer to completion.

Can you transform your unexpected inheritance into the museum of your dreams?
